spanish: Y fueron hijos de Israel en el desierto, y hallaron varón recogiendo leños en día del shabat.

findings.issue: הַשַּׁבָּת is a common noun with the article (H7676), not a proper name; "shabat" leaves the lemma untranslated instead of a Spanish common noun.

notes: The other tokens match: 3mp היו/מצאו, construct בני־ישראל, locative במדבר, singular איש, active participle מקשש, plural עצים, and construct ביום plus the article on שבת.
